title: Dann halt später
desc: A cancelled train, and the word that closes it
setting: Platform four on a Tuesday morning, a board that says Fällt aus, and twenty-two minutes.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Der fällt aus. Der nächste geht um zwanzig nach.
steps.en: That one is cancelled. The next goes at twenty past.

options.en: Then we will just go later.
options.feedback: The whole sentence. There is a shrug in the middle of it and it closes the subject.
A complaint is allowed and this one is a bit long and a bit true. Two minutes, then stop.
For twenty-two minutes. He will not say anything and he will remember it.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Das ist diese Woche schon das zweite Mal.
steps.en: That is the second time this week.

options.feedback: Agreement, no enthusiasm, and it hands the subject back to him. Exactly the right size.

options.es: Ja, absolut, das ist wirklich unmöglich.
options.en: Yes, absolutely, that really is impossible.
options.feedback: Three times too much. He was making conversation, not an argument.

options.es: Bei uns zu Hause wäre das normal.
options.en: At home that would be normal.
options.feedback: Comparing your old country to this one, out loud, over four minutes. It never lands well.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.en: Do you want to get a coffee?

options.es: Ja, gern. Ich gehe mal schauen.
options.en: Yes, gladly. I will go and have a look.
options.feedback: Mal, in the middle, doing nothing and softening the whole thing.
Fine, and it leaves him standing on a platform for twenty minutes with nothing.

options.en: But we do not have time.
options.feedback: Doch in the middle is a reproach here. You have twenty-two minutes.
The number, exactly. He will send you the difference this evening and mean it.
It does. Nobody here wants to carry even a small debt, and refusing to say makes one.

options.en: Will you get the next one?
options.feedback: Warm, and it turns four fifty into an arrangement. Just say the number.
